knowledge_entries.name: compass_cases_in_collection_1
knowledge_entries.text: In the Collection 1 zone, located around coordinates (-3.7, -4.7), there are several compass cases such as objects 001, 007, 013, and 019. These compass cases are maritime navigation tools designed to protect compasses from environmental damage, crucial for accurate navigation at sea. They illustrate historical and functional aspects of maritime navigation equipment.

knowledge_entries.name: buoy_models_in_collection_1
knowledge_entries.text: Also in Collection 1, buoy models like objects 004, 010, 016, and 022 demonstrate maritime safety equipment used to mark navigational hazards or safe channels. Positioned near the compass cases, these models help visitors understand buoy functions and designs important for maritime safety.

knowledge_entries.name: maritime_navigation_tools_and_safety_equipment
knowledge_entries.text: Collection 1 showcases key maritime navigation tools and safety equipment, including compass cases and buoy models. These objects collectively highlight the technology used historically to ensure safe and accurate sea travel, supporting visitor goals to learn about navigation and safety.

knowledge_entries.name: ship_models_in_collection_2
knowledge_entries.text: Collection 2, centered near (1.4, -3.7), features ship models such as objects 002, 008, 014, and 020. These models represent various vessel types and illustrate the evolution of ship design, providing insights into maritime history and engineering.

knowledge_entries.name: anchor_displays_in_collection_2
knowledge_entries.text: Within Collection 2, anchor displays including objects 005, 011, 017, and 023 demonstrate anchoring mechanisms used to secure ships. These exhibits explain the technology behind anchoring and its importance in maritime operations.

knowledge_entries.name: ship_design_and_anchoring_mechanisms
knowledge_entries.text: The exhibits in Collection 2 combine ship models and anchor displays to educate visitors on ship design principles and anchoring technology. This zone highlights how vessel construction and anchoring evolved to meet maritime challenges.

knowledge_entries.name: anchoring_technology_in_maritime_history
knowledge_entries.text: Anchoring mechanisms displayed in Collection 2 illustrate the development of maritime safety and vessel stability techniques. These objects provide context on how anchors function and their role in historical and modern shipping.

knowledge_entries.name: sail_diagrams_in_collection_3
knowledge_entries.text: Collection 3, located near (-1.4, 1.4), contains sail diagrams such as objects 003, 009, 015, and 021. These diagrams explain sailing techniques and the design of sails, helping visitors understand how wind power was harnessed for navigation.

knowledge_entries.name: navigation_charts_in_collection_3
knowledge_entries.text: Also in Collection 3 are navigation charts like objects 006, 012, 018, and 024. These charts demonstrate maritime navigation methods, including route plotting and coastal mapping, essential for safe sea travel.

knowledge_entries.name: maritime_navigation_methods_and_sailing_technology
knowledge_entries.text: The exhibits in Collection 3 combine sail diagrams and navigation charts to educate visitors on maritime navigation methods and sailing technology. This zone provides practical insights into how sailors used charts and sails to navigate the seas.

knowledge_entries.name: sailing_technology_explained
knowledge_entries.text: Collection 3's sail diagrams and navigation charts collectively showcase the technology behind sailing and navigation. Visitors learn about the interplay of wind, sail design, and chart reading in maritime travel.
